Great news — your fridge is packed with beautiful fresh produce! 🥦🥗 Before I dive into dinner suggestions, let me check in:

> 🔍 **Did I miss anything?** Are there items in closed containers I couldn't see into, or any condiments/proteins in the door shelves? Also, is anything nearly finished that I shouldn't rely on? (e.g. eggs, feta)

---

Here's what I spotted in your fridge:

| Section | Ingredients |
|---|---|
| 🥬 Leafy Veg | Butter lettuce, spinach/chard, fresh parsley |
| 🥦 Veg | Broccoli, red cabbage, white/napa cabbage, kohlrabi, watermelon radish *(use soon!)*, beetroot, baby carrots |
| 🧀 Dairy | Feta cheese, butter, eggs (6–8) |
| 🫙 Jars/Preserved | Tomato sauce/passata (3 jars!), olives/preserved fruit, small jar (unknown) |
| 🍋 Fresh | Lemons (2–3), orange juice |

---

## 🍽️ Tonight's Dinner Ideas

Based purely on what's in your fridge, here are **3 quick options** (all ~30 mins or less):

---

### 🥚 1. Shakshuka with Feta & Spinach
**Uses:** Eggs, tomato passata, spinach, parsley, feta, butter
A rich, spiced tomato sauce with eggs poached right in the pan — topped with crumbled feta and fresh parsley. Serve with crusty bread if you have some. Pure comfort food! ⏱ ~20 mins

---

### 🥗 2. Warm Roasted Veggie & Feta Salad
**Uses:** Broccoli, carrots, beetroot, kohlrabi, feta, butter lettuce, lemon
Roast the broccoli, carrots, and beetroot with butter and lemon, then serve over butter lettuce with crumbled feta, a lemon drizzle, and fresh parsley. ⏱ ~30 mins

---

### 🥬 3. Braised Cabbage with Eggs & Parsley
**Uses:** Red cabbage, white cabbage, eggs, butter, parsley, lemon
Sauté and braise the cabbages in butter with a squeeze of lemon, then top with fried or poached eggs and a shower of fresh parsley. Simple, hearty, and delicious! ⏱ ~25 mins

---

**My top pick tonight?** The **Shakshuka** 🍅🥚 — it uses the passata you already have, it's fast, and it's a crowd-pleaser! Plus it'd use up those eggs and spinach that are best eaten soon.

Would you like a full recipe for any of these, or shall I use this fridge inventory to plan your whole week of meals? 😊
